decisions.basis: Submitted result lists cannot define their own denominator.
decisions.choice: Regenerate required obligations from separately selected byte-bound theory, relation, population and endpoint inputs.

decisions.basis: Provider success and its own replay cannot independently validate witness truth.
decisions.choice: Use a separately implemented finite structure validator and satisfaction evaluator following C02 mathematical denotation.

decisions.basis: A witness checker does not prove generic enumerator completeness or unbounded entailment.
decisions.choice: Check finite witnesses only; bounded exhaustion and unavailable kernels stay unverified.

decisions.basis: Selected types and exact bytes do not establish translation fidelity.
decisions.choice: Keep source meaning, semantic closure and owner review pending.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Omit a statement, change a witness, substitute a dependency or provider build; all rejected; historical proof remains historical rather than deleted.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Resolve the required set independently from submitted result list; rehash all inputs and current bindings; check model witnesses against independent denotation; distinguish checker trust from mechanized proof; reject incomplete submissions.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Omit a statement, change a witness, substitute a dependency or provider build; all rejected; historical proof remains historical rather than deleted.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
